## Activity

This report summarises activity at Oakridge Primary Care during October 2020. The site recorded 41 captures during the reporting period. Capture activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in line with the expected schedule apart from routine leave. No additional operational issues were recorded in the information provided.

## Image quality

All 41 captures were available for grading. There were 0 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 0.0. This indicates that no images from the reporting period were excluded from the grading process because of image quality. The available images therefore supported completion of the planned review activity.

## Grading

A total of 5 captures were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1. This reflects the central grading wait recorded for the reporting period. Overall, the activity at Oakridge Primary Care was completed with no ungradable captures, while the referable results and grading lag were recorded for routine monitoring. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.
